description: EVERY held ruling (nutartis) matching structured filters - court level (teismo instancija), court, date range, topic, case type - newest first, with the exact total and counts by level and year, page by page to the end (`next_cursor`). Use it when the job is 'all of them': all regional labour rulings since a date, every Constitutional Court ruling of a year. Every row says the ruling's outcome (granted, dismissed, partly, remanded...) with its operative words; `outcome` lists only the rulings decided that way. search_practice RANKS passages by a question and stops at a limit; this lists. At least one filter is required.

category.description: The court's own category code; a prefix lists everything under it (`43.5`).
category.title: Category

court_level.description: Which level of the court hierarchy to list: `supreme`, `appeal`, `regional`, `district`, `supreme_administrative`, `regional_administrative`, `constitutional` (one or several).
court_level.title: Court Level

courts.description: Named courts, written as the court names itself, e.g. `Vilniaus apygardos teismas`.
courts.title: Courts

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

decided_after.description: Only rulings decided on or after this date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
decided_after.title: Decided After

decided_before.description: Only rulings decided on or before this date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
decided_before.title: Decided Before

include.description: Bring back what is left out by default, e.g. `cassation_admission` (the Supreme Court's rulings on whether to accept an appeal).
include.title: Include

limit.description: Rulings per page, default 50, at most 200. Every page states the exact total.
limit.title: Limit

outcome.description: Keep rulings whose operative part decides this way: `granted`, `partly`, `dismissed`, `remanded`, `not_admitted`, `terminated` (one or several) - e.g. sort the Supreme Court's practice into appeals granted and dismissed. Read from each ruling's own operative words (`outcome.quote` on every row, listed with or without this filter); rulings it could not read are counted under `withheld`. At most 1,000 rulings are read per call: narrow by date or court above that.
outcome.title: Outcome

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

topic.description: A branch of the courts' own case classifier, e.g. `labour`. Rulings with no topical code cannot be judged by it; the answer counts them under `withheld`.
topic.title: Topic

name: list_practice
title: List all matching rulings
